h1: Custom Two Tone Gift Sets & Bundles
metaTitle: Custom Two Tone Gift Sets & Bundles | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order branded two tone gift sets and bundles for corporate events. Perfect Imprints offers custom decoration on bulk orders.
introHtml: Two tone gift sets and bundles combine two complementary colors or materials in one coordinated package, giving your corporate gifts a polished, intentional look. Whether you are pairing a navy blue notebook with a matching pen or a black tumbler with a charcoal tech accessory, the dual-color approach adds visual interest without overwhelming your logo. These sets work well for employee recognition programs, trade show giveaways, or client appreciation kits where you want a cohesive but not monochromatic presentation. Decoration options include screen printing, laser engraving, and full-color imprinting on both components.
heroAltText: Custom two tone gift sets bundles with branded notebooks and pens in contrasting colors
